goDecisionReasons: Thirteen fields retain frozen, field-semantic deterministic extraction capability under accepted readiness policy v3.

All four breadth groups retain at least one planned-capable field; deployment-self-hosting remains the sole infrastructure/deployment field and may realize through either of two registered exact-commit facts.
The six M3A full-closure candidates remain separately identified and unchanged.
Independent review accepts the pre-live architecture lineage rooted at 99713ff00e9e1b226c7a573ac38c152969babf90; live collection remains separately unauthorized.
No provider value, credential, all-candidate projection, or M3 coverage informed this source hardening.

fields.versionScope: Exact catalog npm mapping and exact published npm version with an explicit exports, main, or module runtime entry point.
positiveFacts: importable-runtime-package-surface: an exact npm version publishes an explicit importable runtime entry point
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: No package mapping, publication failure, or missing entry-point property proves no package, service, sidecar, or managed adoption form.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: Other adoption forms and the complete adoption-unit concept set remain unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: A complete profile value still requires closure of every applicable adoption concept; this rule supplies only a positive importable-runtime-package surface.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Mutable registry resolution cutoff and exact immutable package version are retained.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: An explicit exact-version runtime entry point establishes a package adoption surface; publication alone is insufficient and no other adoption form is excluded.

fields.versionScope: Review must bind exact source revisions and taxonomy digest.
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: README, descriptions, topics, and missing declarations prove no feature absence.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: The complete feature set remains unknown without accepted human review.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every applicable controlled feature must be classified under accepted review.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: No bounded machine-readable source declares the complete accepted feature vocabulary.

fields.versionScope: Mutable GitHub repository metadata snapshot at cutoff.
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Null, unsupported, or missing repository primary language proves no language or ecosystem absence; npm package ecosystem is not a language fact.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: Additional implementation and consumer ecosystems remain unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: Complete profile value requires all applicable language ecosystems.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Repository metadata collectedAt/effectiveAsOf and mutable-source limitation are retained.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The accepted primary-language mapping establishes one repository language/ecosystem fact; it does not close the repository or consumer language set.

fields.versionScope: Exact latest npm version selected at cutoff.
positiveFacts: exact published package version and publication time
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Mapped absence or incomplete metadata is unknown; catalog-unmapped is legal deterministic not-applicable.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: None when mapped authority is complete or catalog-unmapped is proved.
fields.completenessRequirement: Exact identity, latest version object, and publish time close mapped candidates.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Registry cutoff and exact immutable version are retained.
fields.rationale: The M3A completeness audit remains sound.

positiveFacts: npm package format, engine range, module format, and exports declaration
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Complete optional-property omission is known; unsupported or incomplete input is unknown; catalog-unmapped is legal not-applicable.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: None when mapped authority is complete or catalog-unmapped is proved.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Exact version and registry cutoff retained.
fields.rationale: The M3A completeness audit remains sound.

positiveFacts: declared-framework-peer-relation: controlled framework peer package and exact declared version range
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Missing peer declaration never proves incompatibility or no compatibility; ordinary runtime dependencies do not establish this fact.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: Undeclared frameworks and compatibility beyond the exact declaration remain unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: A complete profile value requires closure of every supported framework.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: An exact peer dependency establishes only a narrow declared framework package relation; ordinary runtime dependency presence and omission do not establish compatibility.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Missing dependency declaration never proves no datastore requirement.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: Other datastore requirements and whether every declaration is operationally mandatory remain unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: A complete profile value requires closure of every runtime-required datastore.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Any future accepted source must bind an exact immutable version or structured snapshot cutoff.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: A client dependency can be optional, one backend among many, or an implementation detail; it does not establish a datastore requirement.

fields.versionScope: Registry snapshot and catalog repository identity.
positiveFacts: matched, mismatched, or complete undeclared package repository linkage
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Only complete repository-property omission establishes undeclared; incomplete source is unknown; catalog-unmapped is legal not-applicable.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: None under complete mapped metadata or catalog-unmapped proof.
fields.completenessRequirement: Complete exact-package metadata and normalized identity.
fields.rationale: The M3A completeness audit remains sound.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Manifest or path absence proves no empty required-infrastructure set.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: All required infrastructure remains unknown pending accepted review.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every required concept must be classified.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Manifest or path absence proves no empty optional-infrastructure set.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: All optional infrastructure remains unknown pending accepted review.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every optional concept must be classified.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Optionality remains semantic and incomplete under machine authority.

fields.versionScope: Exact validated default-branch Git commit and root tree; only exact root compose.json and exact root Dockerfile are eligible source paths.
positiveFacts: repository-container-build-declaration: an exact root Dockerfile contains an unambiguous direct FROM stage declaration
repository-self-build-compose-service: an exact root Compose service declares repository-root build context
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Missing compose.json or Dockerfile is source-path absence only. It proves no absence of self-hosting, container deployment, managed deployment, or any other operating mode.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: Build success, production suitability, capability coverage, complete deployment modes, and operational requirements remain unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: The complete field remains unknown. Either registered affirmative exact-commit fact can make this one field realized-ready, but neither closes deployment-self-hosting semantics.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Repository identity, mutable default-branch ref resolution, exact Git commit, exact root tree, exact blob SHA, source digest, and cutoff are retained.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Candidate-linked root Compose self-build services and verified root Dockerfile FROM declarations are narrow affirmative deployment facts. They do not establish complete self-hosting, and the field still counts only once.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Paths and manifests prove no complete process, scheduling, or storage model by omission.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: All process roles and both required booleans remain unknown pending accepted review.
fields.completenessRequirement: Every process role and both booleans must be closed.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The selected deployment partial rule avoids falsely closing the operational model.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: NOASSERTION, null, 404, or missing license remains unknown and never favorable.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: License identity remains unknown when the provider cannot establish recognized SPDX.
fields.completenessRequirement: Recognized SPDX closes a positive value only.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Exact head and collection cutoff retained.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The existing positive SPDX rule is nontrivial and fail-closed even though provider non-detection cannot close all candidates.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Complete archived=false proves the negative at snapshot; provider failure is unknown.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: None after exact identity and total Boolean resolve.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The M3A completeness audit remains sound.

positiveFacts: last commit time and exact closed-window commit count, including zero
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Only pagination-closed zero proves zero; transient or unclosed window is unknown.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: None after exact head and closed window.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Window end equals cutoff; head SHA retained.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The M3A completeness audit remains sound.

positiveFacts: selected non-draft exact release tag and publication state
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Only a closed empty set proves no release; an unresolved bounded window or failure is unknown.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: When pagination is unclosed, older releases and complete release state remain unknown.
fields.completenessRequirement: Complete field requires pagination closure; positive release facts may survive an incomplete window.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: A selected exact release is direct evidence even when the bounded source cannot close the field.

fields.versionScope: Exact npm package and version at snapshot.
positiveFacts: observed applicable advisory ID and severity for exact package version
fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Zero is known only under complete exact-query pagination; partial pagination and repository-only scope remain unknown.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: Unseen advisories and repository-only advisory scope remain unknown when source closure is unavailable.
fields.completenessRequirement: Complete count and severity require exact identity and closed pagination; observed matching advisories remain positive direct evidence.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: Exact matching advisories are nontrivial direct evidence; only complete pagination can prove zero.

fields.negativeAbsenceSemantics: Only complete normalized false or accepted established absence proves no policy; transient failure is unknown.
fields.unresolvedRemainder: None after exact identity and complete normalized outcome.
fields.completenessRequirement: Exact repository and complete provider Boolean or controlled absence.
fields.freshnessRequirement: Snapshot cutoff and mutable limitation retained.
fields.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fields.rationale: The M3A completeness audit remains sound.
